newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's June mined copper output dips 1.3 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's June mined copper output dips 1.3 percent.

text.p: Peru's copper output dipped 1.3 percent to 41,589 tonnes in June compared with the same month last year, according to preliminary figures released Thursday by the Energy and Mines Ministry.
Copper output rose 5.4 percent to 247,000 tonnes in the first half of the year, compared with the same period last year, the ministry added in its monthly report.
In 1996, Peru's copper output rose by 18.1 percent to 483,880 tonnes from 409,693 tonnes in 1995.
Peru is the world's sixth largest copper producer. The country's largest producer, Southern Peru Limited, accounts for around 60 percent of the country's output.
